zh: 子序列的代价只由相邻两个选中元素决定，所以可以按“已选了多少个、最后一个是谁”来做动态规划：dp[t][i] 表示选了 t 个且以 i 结尾的最小代价。
转移是对所有 j<i 求 dp[t−1][j] + |a[i] − a[j]| 的最小值。按 a[j] 与 a[i] 的大小拆掉绝对值：a[j] ≤ a[i] 时是 (dp[j] − a[j]) + a[i]，a[j] ≥ a[i] 时是 (dp[j] + a[j]) − a[i]，于是变成两个按值域的区间最小值查询。
先把数值离散化。每一层长度 t 新建两棵最小值线段树（或树状结构）；从左到右扫描 i：先在第一棵树查值不超过 a[i] 的前缀最小值加 a[i]，在第二棵树查值不小于 a[i] 的后缀最小值减 a[i]，两者取小作为当前层 dp[i]；再把上一层的 dp[i] − a[i] 和 dp[i] + a[i] 插入两棵树，保证只用到更早的元素。长度为 1 时代价为 0，做完 k 层后取最小值。
en: The cost of a subsequence depends only on adjacent chosen elements, so do dynamic programming over how many elements have been chosen and which one is last: dp[t][i] is the minimum cost of choosing t elements ending at i.

The transition takes the minimum of dp[t-1][j] + |a[i] - a[j]| over j < i. Split the absolute value by comparing a[j] with a[i]: when a[j] <= a[i] it is (dp[j] - a[j]) + a[i], and when a[j] >= a[i] it is (dp[j] + a[j]) - a[i], which turns into two range-minimum queries over the value domain.

Compress the values first. For each length t build two fresh min segment trees; scan i from left to right: query the first tree for the prefix minimum over values not above a[i] and add a[i], query the second tree for the suffix minimum over values not below a[i] and subtract a[i], and take the smaller as this layer's dp[i]; only then insert the previous layer's dp[i] - a[i] and dp[i] + a[i] into the two trees, so only earlier elements are used. Length 1 costs 0; after k layers take the minimum.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Do dynamic programming over the subsequence length. The transition is `min_j(dp[j]+|a[i]-a[j]|)`; split it into a prefix minimum of `dp[j]-a[j]` and a suffix minimum of `dp[j]+a[j]` over values in sorted order, and update them while scanning. Exhaustive enumeration of combinations provides an independent check.

## Proof of correctness

The dp value for length t ending at i enumerates every predecessor j<i, and the transition `dp[t−1][j]+|a[i]−a[j]|` covers every valid subsequence. After splitting the values of j by size, the two range minima are each maintained by a segment tree; taking the minimum over all endings with length k gives the global optimum.

## Complexity

This site adds n≤800 so that the O(kn log n) solution is feasible; |arr[i]|≤10^9.

O(kn log n) time, O(n) space.

## Reference implementation

```python
def solve(raw):
 import bisect
 z=list(map(int,raw.split()));n,k=z[:2];a=z[2:2+n];v=sorted(set(a));m=len(v);size=1
 while size<m:size*=2
 INF=10**30;prev=[0]*n
 for length in range(2,k+1):
  lo=[INF]*(2*size);hi=[INF]*(2*size);cur=[INF]*n
  def query(tree,l,r):
   l+=size;r+=size;ans=INF
   while l<r:
    if l&1:ans=min(ans,tree[l]);l+=1
    if r&1:r-=1;ans=min(ans,tree[r])
    l//=2;r//=2
   return ans
  def update(tree,pos,val):
   pos+=size;tree[pos]=min(tree[pos],val);pos//=2
   while pos:tree[pos]=min(tree[2*pos],tree[2*pos+1]);pos//=2
  for i,x in enumerate(a):
   t=bisect.bisect_left(v,x);cur[i]=min(query(lo,0,t+1)+x,query(hi,t,m)-x)
   if prev[i]<INF:update(lo,t,prev[i]-x);update(hi,t,prev[i]+x)
  prev=cur
 return str(min(prev))
```
